/*
 * DOOM (the doomgeneric port), amalgamated into a single C file.
 *
 * Generated by build.sh from src/: DOOM's own headers and macros have been
 * expanded and its platform #ifdefs resolved, so what follows is plain C99
 * that depends only on the ISO C headers below and on the seven host
 * functions declared after them.
 * Sound, floating point and 64-bit integers have been removed; see
 * README.md for the full list of changes against upstream.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 1993-1996 Id Software, Inc.
 * Copyright (C) 2005-2014 Simon Howard
 * doomgeneric port: Copyright (C) 2015 ozkl and contributors
 *
 * This program is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it
 * under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the
 * Free Software Foundation; either version 2 of the License, or (at your
 * option) any later version. See LICENSE.
 */

#include <ctype.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

/*
 * Host interface. This is everything DOOM needs beyond ISO C; the host
 * implements these seven functions. DOOM draws into DG_ScreenBuffer,
 * 640x400 pixels of 0x00RRGGBB, and calls DG_DrawFrame() to show it.
 * DG_GetKey() reports the next key press (pressed=1) or release
 * (pressed=0) as a DOOM key code (see README.md), returning 0 when there
 * is none. DG_GetTicksMs() is a millisecond clock; DG_SleepMs() sleeps.
 * DG_MakeDirectory() creates a directory for savegames and may just fail.
 */
extern uint32_t *DG_ScreenBuffer;
void DG_Init(void);
void DG_DrawFrame(void);
void DG_SleepMs(uint32_t ms);
uint32_t DG_GetTicksMs(void);
int DG_GetKey(int *pressed, unsigned char *key);
void DG_SetWindowTitle(const char *title);
int DG_MakeDirectory(const char *path);
